Class Game

java.lang.Object
it.polimi.it.Game
public class Game extends Object
Pure game model (Model role in MVC). Responsibilities: - Hold the complete game state - Enforce the game rules - Publish immutable GameEvents to registered listeners - Validate and apply PlayerActions received via execute() Does not know the controller, the view, or the network layer. Internal state machine (Phase): WAITING -> PLACING_TOTEMS -> RESOLVING_ACTIONS -> POST_ROUND -> (loop | ENDED) Offer Track note: the number of tiles is always players+1 (one tile is never used each round). The action phase starts when placed totems == players.size(), not when no free tiles remain.

    • getWinners

      public List<Player> getWinners()
      Returns the winner(s) based on prestigePoints (which include end-game bonuses after endGame() has applied them). Tiebreaker: most food. Absolute tie: shared victory (rulebook p.7). Must only be called from endGame().
